angles.reason: Repeated+/-360 can stall for infinities or huge finite values with insufficient double progress. Never normalize outside oracle.
angles.safe_domain: Required bounded grids0,90,180,270,360 and reviewed nearby negatives/wraps are candidates. No blanket finite-angle safe domain.
angles.unknown: Full progress/time bound unknown;extreme and nonfinite angular cases unavailable pending qualification. Loop in SurfaceInputs belongs to updateSurfaceInputs,not bare setWindDirection.

aspen.safe_domain: Exact model1..5, derived model-1 index0..4;severity Low0 or Moderate1.
aspen.unknown: Storage/type guards do not certify numerical or scientific validity.

aspen_curing.reason: NaN bypasses clamps/comparisons. Loop incorrectly uses sizeof(array)-1 bytes and can overrun for NaN.
aspen_curing.safe_domain: Require finite curing;clamped[0,1],then interpolation breaks at i1..5;indices i-1/i stay0..5.
aspen_curing.unknown: Storage/type guards do not certify numerical or scientific validity.

chaparral.reason: isGoodSizeClassIndex tests only sizeClass<5 and ignores lifeState.
chaparral.safe_domain: lifeState0..1;sizeClass0..4 including lower bound;fuel typeNotSet0/Chamise1/MixedBrush2;load mode1 or2.
chaparral.unknown: Storage/type guards do not certify numerical or scientific validity.

chaparral_date.reason: Month>2 rule and ineffective negative-days expression are quirks; do not repair in driver.
chaparral_date.safe_domain: Exact integer month/day;documented1..12 and1..31. C++ clamps month<1 to1,month>2 to12,and day1..31;derived days index stays0,1,11.
chaparral_date.unknown: Date semantics need finding; no current port mode counterpart.

fine_derived.reason: Validate primitive and derived bounds before calculate.
fine_derived.unknown: Storage/type guards do not certify numerical or scientific validity.

fine_indices.reason: Only aspect,dry-bulb,and elevation upper bounds are compared upstream.

fresh_state.reason: Deleted/default constructors and dependent pointers require care. Never expose protected equations by subclass/macros.

fresh_state.unknown: Storage/type guards do not certify numerical or scientific validity.

fuel_custom.reason: Port rejects registration0/257, but a defined custom256 can burn. Never send256 to C++.
fuel_custom.safe_domain: Shared custom-registration subset1..255,only unreserved IDs for successful registration. C++ storage0..255 is not registration validity. Port custom256 is port-only.
fuel_custom.unknown: Storage/type guards do not certify numerical or scientific validity.

fuel_storage.reason: Vector has256 entries; definition query accepts256; unchecked load access precedes run definition checks.
fuel_storage.safe_domain: Exact integer0..255 before ANY setter, getter, definition query, registration, or run.
fuel_storage.unknown: Storage/type guards do not certify numerical or scientific validity.

integer_conversion.reason: Driver schema requirement;not a claim current native adapters enforce these checks.
integer_conversion.safe_domain: Exact mathematical integer and representable target C++ int,then index/enum bound BEFORE cast. Reject fractional,nonfinite,overflow,and booleans used as IDs.
integer_conversion.unknown: Target int width awaits build spike;do not assume host Python integer range is C++ range.

life_particle.reason: External getter indices must be checked even after a valid run.
life_particle.safe_domain: FuelLifeState exactly Dead0 or Live1; particle storage indices0..4 in[2][5]. Semantic dead classes may be narrower(MaxDeadSizeClasses4).
life_particle.unknown: Storage/type guards do not certify numerical or scientific validity.

mortality_equations.reason: Free port logistic coefficient matrix has no matching C++ public input; species-specific calculation differs.
mortality_equations.safe_domain: Select actual species record and its EquationType;required-field enum slots within actual vector size;never interpret port equation number as C++ species index.
mortality_equations.unknown: Storage/type guards do not certify numerical or scientific validity.

numeric_unknown.reason: Index safety does not prove physical validity or finite results.
numeric_unknown.safe_domain: No blanket certified numerical domain. Qualify pow/log/sqrt/division/overflow,zero,nonfinite,and extrema per equation.
numeric_unknown.unknown: Source-only investigation;zero executed oracle cases. Unassessed domains remain unavailable.

scenario.reason: Fresh registry needed;names must resolve before scenario mode.
scenario.safe_domain: Integer index0<=i<current registry size;definition query and selected-scenario setter must succeed;keep registry alive.
scenario.unknown: Storage/type guards do not certify numerical or scientific validity.

slope_tables.unknown: Storage/type guards do not certify numerical or scientific validity.

species.reason: Unchecked wrappers and a second derived table access occur in full mortality.

Crown.limitation: Critical spread/intensity,transition/active ratios,crowning-surface spread,and passive-only fields lack direct public getters. Their scalar equations remain not_executable.
run: Exactly one of doCrownRunRothermel or doCrownRunScottAndReinhardt
setters_in_order: updateCrownInputs(all declared surface and canopy inputs/units)

FineDeadFuelMoistureTool.canonical_units: Eight categorical class indices;output Fraction or Percent.

FireSize.limitation: No independent backing/ratio setters;arbitrary port scalar input tuples may not be representable.

Ignite.limitation: calculateFuelTemperature protected;lightning absent from callable API.

Mortality.limitation: Full run disabled pending record and derived-index audit. Generic port coefficient input differs.
setters_in_order: all remaining fields required by actual record

Safety.limitation: Individual count setters double;bulk updateSafetyInputs counts int,so is not used for fractional port counts.

Spot.canonical_units: Feet,Inches,MilesPerHour;explicit location,ridge distance/elevation,canopy mode,and tree species where required.
getters: Matching getMaxFlatTerrainSpottingDistanceFrom...(Feet) and mountain getter if requested
Spot.limitation: Abbreviated getter family must be selected from actual API inventory IDs;port simplified formulas not established equivalent.
setters_in_order: updateSpotInputsForBurningPile OR updateSpotInputsForSurfaceFire OR updateSpotInputsForTorchingTrees(all declaration parameters)
Surface::updateSurfaceInputs(all declared scalar inputs and unit enums)

SurfaceIntermediates.limitation: No arbitrary p/ib dictionary injection;not all Python particle fields observable.

Units.canonical_units: First member of each of17 quantity enums in enum-domains.json.
Units.limitation: Stateless;conversion overflow and signed-zero/nonfinite differences unqualified.

state_unit_contracts.independent_case_rule: Fresh objects per independent case;explicit transition cases only;validate every primitive/derived bound before every call,including setters and getters.
state_unit_contracts.status: Source-only candidate schemas;semantic argument lists are abbreviated. Exact signatures/API IDs in cpp-route-bounds.json and full API inventory control declaration order. No runtime qualification.
